description: Defines structs, enums, and functions related to feature and workaround management in the ANGLE project, including feature categories, feature properties, and utility functions.

classes.name: angle::Feature
classes.description: Represents a feature or workaround with properties like name, category, description, bug link, enabled status, and condition.

classes.name: angle::FeatureSetBase
classes.description: Base class managing a collection of features, allowing feature override and listing.

methods.name: angle::FeatureCategoryToString
methods.description: Converts a FeatureCategory enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: angle::FeatureStatusToString
methods.description: Converts a boolean feature status to its string representation ('enabled' or 'disabled').

methods.name: angle::Feature::Feature
methods.description: Constructor for Feature, initializes properties and optionally adds to a feature map.

methods.name: angle::FeatureSetBase::overrideFeatures
methods.description: Overrides the enabled status of specified features.

methods.name: angle::FeatureSetBase::populateFeatureList
methods.description: Populates a list with all features in the set.
